notes: Post-Phase-5 hardening case for a second postwar influenza-wave family.

label: H1N1 second-wave pressure in 2009-2010

source_assertions.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source_assertions.claim: Raphael's epidemic appendix explicitly supports peak and return-wave logic, while his broader public-health doctrine allows fever/infection and hospital-burden signatures to recur in later epidemics.

source_assertions.title: CDC MMWR on the 2009-2010 influenza season
source_assertions.claim: CDC's 2009-2010 influenza summary describes the autumn 2009 H1N1 resurgence as the second wave of the pandemic in the United States.

notes: Post-Phase-5 hardening case for modern secondary-wave logic beyond 1919 and 2021.

label: Omicron global surge in early 2022

source_assertions.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source_assertions.claim: Raphael's disease and institutional-burden doctrine allows sudden epidemic acceleration and widespread health-system pressure to be judged as a wave problem rather than only as static public-health burden.

source_assertions.title: WHO Weekly epidemiological update on COVID-19 - 11 January 2022
source_assertions.claim: WHO reported in January 2022 that global weekly COVID-19 cases rose sharply to the highest levels of the pandemic during the Omicron surge, while many regions saw steep wave-like acceleration.

notes: Post-Phase-5 hardening case for a rapid global COVID wave outside the India 2021 surge window.
